message.content: {"basis":"The dashboard displays a clear conflict between the bar geometry and the printed percentage labels. The 'Wind' bar is the tallest (reaching ~68 on the y-axis), but it is labeled '29.8%'. The 'Solar' bar is shorter (reaching ~40) but is labeled '41.2%'. Because the printed percentages (41.2%, 29.8%, 18.5%, 7.2%, 3.3%) sum to exactly 100.0%, they represent the definitive contribution distribution for the sources. The bar heights appear to be a rendering error or a different scale, as they do not match the explicit percentage data. Therefore, Solar is the largest contribution source at 41.2%.", "option_label":"Route Solar for priority contribution follow-up"}
